prompt: Provide a brief description of object-oriented polymorphism. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use verbs. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Format as a semicolon-delimited single line.
evaluation_criteria:
No Verbs: 0-5 (Evaluates noun/adjective phrase structure)
Semicolon Format: 0-5 (Evaluates single line semicolon layout)
response_text: A mechanism allowing different classes to share a common interface while maintaining distinct internal implementations; enables unified treatment of varied data types through inheritance and method overriding; supports flexible, extensible code without altering existing structures; runtime binding determines actual behavior based on object type; promotes abstraction over concrete specifics.
